unexecuted_ranges_with_waivers.reason: Unknown/non-Error normalization fallback; real native ConstraintError/VersionError and quota errors already exercise the storage mapping. No platform known-error shape needs this fallback.
Defensive abort-after-settlement catch; every actual IndexedDB fault/abort in scope settles during an active transaction. It cannot publish data.
